title: Japan decides to reduce consumption tax to 1% for food and prepares bill
summary: The government and ruling party agree to temporarily reduce the consumption tax on food to 1% to ease inflationary pressure, although the national council fails to reach consensus and Prime Minister Takichi orders to accelerate the submission of the bill.

title: Famous Japanese writer Keigo Higashino dies at 68
summary: Author of successful novels such as "The Devotion of Suspect X" and "Journey Under the Midnight Sun", his death prompts tributes from actors, publishers, and readers around the world.

title: Japan advances in protecting voice against unauthorized uses, including sexual deepfakes
summary: A committee of the Ministry of Justice proposes to recognize the voice as a right of publicity and allow damage lawsuits, including for sexual deepfakes, marking an important step in AI regulation.

title: Japan postpones decision on minimum wage, which would be around 1,100 yen per hour
summary: The advisory council of the Ministry of Labor fails to reach consensus on the annual minimum wage increase and postpones the decision, while unions and business associations maintain divergent positions.

title: Japan strengthens its intelligence to counter foreign interference
summary: The ruling LDP proposes a law to sanction foreign interference and Prime Minister Takichi announces the creation of a national intelligence agency, seeking to strengthen national security.

title: Prime Minister Takichi says he has no regrets as he closes extraordinary parliamentary session
summary: In a press conference, Takichi defended his management and stated he has no points of regret, while facing a drop in popularity and criticism from the opposition.

title: Court orders compensation in Matsuhashi case after 41 years of litigation
summary: The Fukuoka High Court ordered the government and Kumamoto prefecture to pay compensation for illegal detentions and forced confessions, deeming the police actions illegal.

title: Bribery scandal in Fukuoka assembly: lawmaker admits paying 5 million yen
summary: Prefectural assembly member Eto confesses to handing over 5 million yen to another member, while the former vice-president of the assembly also testifies about delivering cash, generating pressure within the LDP.

title: House fire in Saga kills four people, including two children
summary: A fire destroyed a home in Imari city, Saga prefecture, claiming the lives of four members of the same family, including two minors.

title: Shinichiro Hattori and Kanta Yanagi advance to the final of the Ryuo shogi tournament
summary: Hattori (7-dan) and Yanagi (5-dan) win their respective semifinals of the Ryuo tournament and will face each other in a three-game series to determine the challenger for the title.

title: Japan weighs participating in meeting on Strait of Hormuz amid regional tensions
summary: The Japanese Defense Minister considers attending a meeting on security in the strait, while it is revealed that a US commander recommended halting airstrikes against Iranian positions.

title: Popularity of Takichi government and LDP declines, internal concern grows
summary: Latest polls show a drop in approval ratings for the cabinet and the ruling party, causing alarm among LDP lawmakers who fear losing public support.

title: Takichi defends his fiscal policy in parliamentary budget committee
summary: During the debate in the budget committee, Prime Minister Takichi stressed the importance of maintaining market confidence in fiscal policy and controlling debt growth.

title: Hokkaido University officially apologizes for collecting Ainu remains without consent
summary: Hokkaido University offers a direct apology for studying Ainu indigenous remains without permission, promising to improve its handling of indigenous peoples' rights.

title: Coast Guard raids Doshisha international school linked to accident at Futenma base
summary: The Japan Coast Guard searches Doshisha International High School in connection with the death of a worker in a helicopter accident at Futenma Air Base, following a family complaint.

title: Osaka governor seeks to hold referendum on metropolis on same day as unified elections
summary: Governor Yoshimura defends the legality of holding a popular consultation on the Osaka Metropolis plan simultaneously with the unified local elections, facing criticism from the opposition who consider it would avoid debate.
